claim: Try it with sample data without saving anything to your real parking lot.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; park one real thought, enter /demo, add a demo thought, start for real, and assert the real lot contains only the real thought.

claim: Thought text and voice clips stay on this device during capture.
sandbox: Fresh /demo session; capture text and a fake-media voice clip while recording requests, then assert every request is same-origin.

claim: Record a short voice clip and park it with a thought.
sandbox: Fresh /demo session with Playwright fake microphone; record, stop, park, review, and assert the local audio control is present.

claim: Use Ctrl/Command+Shift+Space to focus capture from anywhere.
sandbox: Fresh browser context on /privacy; press the desktop shortcut and assert capture opens with its field focused.

claim: Export your parking lot as a versioned JSON backup.
sandbox: Fresh /settings/?demo=1 session; download Export JSON and assert product identifier, version, and every shipped sample record.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh /demo session in a service-worker-controlled browser; add a thought, set browser offline, reload /demo, and review the saved thought.

claim: A $7 one-time supporter license adds a local return snapshot and custom return cue.
where: Landing facts, My data, README, Terms
sandbox: Fresh /demo session; leave with Start for real, assert the prescribed $7 Sociobot checkout link, then mock a valid return token and assert supporter access is restored.
